papers_reviewed.title: Deep Learning Benchmarks for Earnings Call Transcript Analysis
papers_reviewed.summary: Systematic FinBERT vs BERT benchmark on earnings call transcripts. Transcript-tuned FinBERT outperforms generic FinBERT by 8-12% accuracy. Directly applicable to H163/H174 pipeline upgrade path — recommends yiyanghkust/finbert-tone for earnings sentiment tasks.

papers_reviewed.title: Behavioral Momentum: Volume-Price Divergence and Institutional Herding Factors in US Equities
papers_reviewed.summary: Volume-price herding factor (accumulation/distribution via vol-price divergence) achieves OOS Sharpe 0.91, near-zero corr to price momentum (0.08), moderate corr to reversal (0.31). Herding + reversal blend reaches Sharpe 1.24. Opens H197 hypothesis family for 30-stock universe.

papers_reviewed.title: PolyBench: Evaluating Large Language Model Forecasting on Polymarket Binary Prediction Markets
papers_reviewed.summary: All major LLMs perform near-randomly on binary prediction market questions (49-53% accuracy). Only exception: economic data release questions with structured numerical context (+6% edge). Calibration anchor for H185 strategy scope — restrict to CPI/FOMC questions with FRED data.

papers_reviewed.title: MASFIN: A Multi-Agent System for Financial Investment
papers_reviewed.summary: 4-agent bull/bear/risk/allocator debate framework. Reduces max drawdown by 31% vs single-agent LLM on same tasks. Debate pattern applicable as H174 PEAD pre-filter layer — bear analyst catches fake earnings beats. High-risk change to live pipeline; flagged for Kevin review.

papers_reviewed.title: Volume-Synchronized Probability of Informed Trading (VPIN) as Intraday Liquidity Signal
papers_reviewed.summary: VPIN metric for intraday toxicity detection. Relevant to HFT/market-making, not to monthly rebalance strategies in current pipeline. Not staged — no immediate implementation hook.

papers_reviewed.title: FinAgent: An Autonomous LLM Agent for Systematic Financial Research
papers_reviewed.summary: LLM agent that autonomously generates and tests trading hypotheses. Architecture similar to current George pipeline but less structured — no rigorous IS/OOS methodology. Not staged — our pipeline is already more rigorous than the proposed system.

papers_reviewed.title: Calibration of LLM Confidence in Prediction Markets
papers_reviewed.summary: LLM calibration study: models systematically overconfident on 30-day horizon, well-calibrated on 7-day horizon. Relevant to H185 but PolyBench (2604.14199) already covers this with broader scope — not staged separately.

papers_reviewed.title: Cross-Sectional Factor Zoo: Which Anomalies Survive Transaction Costs?
papers_reviewed.summary: Meta-study of 200+ cross-sectional anomalies post-transaction costs. BAB and momentum survive; low-vol decile marginal after costs; reversal expensive at high frequency but cost-effective at monthly rebalance. Consistent with H192-D and H181 findings — no contradictions. Not staged — no new actionable content beyond what low-volatility.md already documents.
